verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-services platform that stores customer documents and offers AI-powered features such as meeting-minute creation, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents a setting or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The llms.txt file only guides AI crawlers on LegalZoom's public site, and the registered-agent address privacy is a different feature, so neither counts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
